from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,os,subprocess,json,statistics,hashlib
work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=work.parents[1]
os.environ['PC_WORK']=str(work)
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pc',root/'experiments/perf-gc-dict-20260925/scripts/pc.py')
pc=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(pc)
pc.LOX_PORT=work/'source-current'
pc.LOX_BENCH=root.parent/'d9-stage3b/.tmp-cow/pc/lox/bench'
program=next(p for p in pc.programs() if p['id']=='lox/vm/method_call')
runs={name:pc.run_spec(program,work/('lox-'+name+'.llvm.sym'),name) for name in ['base','current']}
result={'program':program,'cpu':11,'builds':json.loads((work/'builds.json').read_text()),'checks':{},'counts':{'base':[],'current':[]},'profiles':{}}
for name,run in runs.items():
 result['checks'][name]=pc.check(program,run)
 assert result['checks'][name]['ok'],result['checks'][name]
for rep in range(3):
 for name in (['base','current'] if rep%2==0 else ['current','base']):
  one=pc.perf_counts(runs[name],11)
  assert one['status']==0 and 'instructions' in one,one
  result['counts'][name].append(one)
  print('COUNT',name,one,flush=True)
medians={name:statistics.median(x['instructions'] for x in rows) for name,rows in result['counts'].items()}
result['instruction_medians']=medians
result['instruction_ratio']=medians['current']/medians['base']
print('RATIO',result['instruction_ratio'],flush=True)
(work/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,run in runs.items():
 cmd=['taskset','-c','11','perf','record','-e','cpu_core/instructions/u','-c','100003','-g','--call-graph','fp','-o',str(work/(name+'.perf.data')),'--',*run['argv']]
 with (work/(name+'.profile.out')).open('wb') as out,(work/(name+'.profile.err')).open('wb') as err:
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=run['cwd'],env=run['env'],stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=600)
 result['profiles'][name]={'command':cmd,'status':r.returncode}
 (work/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('PROFILE',name,r.returncode,flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==0

from pathlib import Path

w=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=w.parents[1]
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('MYLANG_')}
env['TMPDIR']=str(root/'.tmp-nested/tmp')
build=json.loads((w/'builds.json').read_text())['base']
for symbols,output,expected in [(False,w/'baseline-recovered','61621ee380e5562967b53d6ba81c54fe28ceb2adc22ad6fa943e6772b7887fa0'),(True,w/'symbols-recovered',build['binary_sha256'])]:
 cmd=build['command'].copy();cmd[cmd.index('-o')+1]=str(output)
 if not symbols:cmd.remove('--keep-symbols')
 print('REBUILD',symbols,flush=True)
 subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=w/'source-base',env=env,check=True)
 digest=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print('SHA',digest,flush=True)
 assert digest==expected,(digest,expected)
 destination=(root.parent/'d9-stage3b/.tmp-cow/pc/bin/base/lox.llvm') if not symbols else w/'lox-base.llvm.sym'
 shutil.copyfile(output,destination)
 assert hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
 print('RESTORED',destination,flush=True)
